infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TouristGuide uses your location to discover nearby points of interest and display interactive map markers.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: TouristGuide needs camera access to let you capture and upload photos of newly discovered locations.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: TouristGuide needs photo library access to select cover images for community spot submissions.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: TouristGuide uses your location to show nearby spots and position your location on the map.

plugins.photosPermission: TouristGuide accesses your photos so you can choose a cover image for community spots.
plugins.cameraPermission: TouristGuide accesses your camera so you can take photos of new places.

plugins.photosPermission: TouristGuide needs access to your media library to save vibrant story cards to your photo gallery.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: TouristGuide saves story card previews to your photo library.
